tools.title: KiCad 10.0.6 (PCB checks, fabrication export, schematic net extraction)
tools.size_note: Compressed linux/amd64 layers plus config from the registry manifest; installed size is the unpacked image on disk.
capabilities: recorded KiCad 5-9 board/schematic format upgrade to KiCad 10 (derivative bundle)
fixed-layer Gerber X2 and circular Excellon export
schematic export and net extraction (XML, version E)
tools.rights: KiCad is GPL-3.0-or-later; library and notice terms stay in the image under /usr/share/doc.
tools.qualification: Synthetic original fixtures only; older KiCad 5-9 boards only through the recorded upgrade derivative; linux/arm64, ERC/parity and assembly outputs are unverified.

tools.title: AVR GCC 5.4.0 (baremetal C11 firmware compile, atmega328p ABI)
tools.size_note: Built locally from toolpacks/firmware/Dockerfile: base pinned by digest, all packages pinned to exact versions from snapshot.debian.org 20261010T000000Z, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1791590400. Two independent --no-cache builds produced this same image ID on Docker 29.9.0 (containerd image store, BuildKit 0.34); the package download size is not recorded. A rebuild must reproduce this ID; if it does not, re-pin here and investigate.
capabilities: firmware compile to ELF32 AVR and Intel HEX (C only, explicit atmega328p ABI)
no flashing, device access or hardware compatibility claim
tools.rights: GCC and binutils are GPL; avr-libc is BSD-style. Notices stay in the image under /usr/share/doc.
tools.qualification: Synthetic C fixtures only; other ABIs, languages, PlatformIO and linux/arm64 are unsupported.
tools.acquire: docker build --network=default --provenance=false --sbom=false --build-arg SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1791590400 -f toolpacks/firmware/Dockerfile -t specmate-firmware-check:avr-gcc-v1 toolpacks/firmware

tools.title: OrcaSlicer 2.4.2 (default FDM slicing of exact frozen print preparations with bundled vendor presets)
tools.size_note: Built locally from toolpacks/slicer/orca/Dockerfile: Ubuntu 24.04 base pinned by digest, release asset OrcaSlicer_Linux_AppImage_Ubuntu2404_V2.4.2.AppImage (137759224 bytes) fetched with ADD --checksum sha256:d12fb8c8eac1aecd2dfb6377acd48f994f8fa439ed5292fa532dd82880f029fd (the GitHub release asset digest), 235 packages pinned to exact versions from snapshot.ubuntu.com 20261010T000000Z, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1791590400. Two independent --no-cache builds produced this same image ID on Docker 29.9.0 (containerd image store, BuildKit 0.34); the package download size is not recorded.
capabilities: FDM plate G-code and sliced 3MF project from an STL mesh, using named vendor presets bundled in the release (exercised: Qidi Q1 Pro, Qidi X-Plus 4, Bambu Lab P1S) plus declared overrides
slicer-stated estimates: print time, filament length, volume and mass, layer count
no printer connection, submission or control
tools.rights: OrcaSlicer is AGPL-3.0; its vendor profiles stay inside the image. Ubuntu package notices stay in the image under /usr/share/doc. Generated outputs carry the rights derived from the staged source bundle.
tools.qualification: Synthetic STL fixtures sliced headless (no display) with the three exercised preset sets; repeated runs gave identical G-code apart from the generation-time header line. Command-line rotation crashes this release and is refused; OBJ/3MF/STEP input, other presets, printability, physical qualification and linux/arm64 are unverified.
tools.acquire: docker build --network=default --provenance=false --sbom=false --build-arg SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1791590400 -f toolpacks/slicer/orca/Dockerfile -t specmate-slicer-check:orcaslicer-2.4.2-v1 toolpacks/slicer/orca
